doctrine: Holiday is a lane/list system. Tracks, PIXs, and KKs are independent of holidays unless the holiday is in the actual title or an admin explicitly marks the item as Christmas, Holiday, or a specific holiday.
rules: No track is tied to Mother's Day because it was used for Mother's Day.
No track is tied to Father's Day because it was used for Father's Day.
No PIX title may be renamed by holiday use.
Holiday use is a temporary presentation context unless admin marks otherwise.
Christmas may stand as a specific holiday exception only when admin-marked or title-supported.
Thank You remains a PIX/track title only.
Ring the Bell remains a PIX/track title only.
Holiday pages select by theme/feeling/metadata, not by prior event history.
